verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials is a fair question for an API-driven payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents restricted, scoped or least-privilege API keys for agents. The MCP server and agent-tooling items show that agents can call the Stripe API, but they say nothing about limiting what those credentials can do, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
